name: Aster da Master API

meta.auth: none - static files; no keys, no rate limits

for_agents: Start at api/v1/index.json. The artist record is the source of truth; data/artist.json feeds the site renderer.
provenance: All artist facts verified against public platform pages (Apple Music, iHeart, Anghami, Shazam, Boomplay, SonicHits, album.link, SoundCloud). v0.5.0: the official SoundCloud profile (asterdamaster) catalog is fully verified — 185 SoundCloud-only tracks (upload dates + play-count snapshot) alongside the 34 distributor releases (219 total). Spotify is artist-linked via the official SoundCloud bio; Instagram + official site likewise bio-linked. 'Litemode Trilogy' is teased in the bio, not confirmed. v0.7.0: global-search slug index + on-this-day (MM-DD) API; homepage gains search overlay, on-this-day section, era intelligence deep-dives, and cast-lots. v0.7.1: year-in-review archive (years/2018-2026.html + api/v1/years.json), methodology page, Litemode Trilogy watch page. v0.9.0: milestones endpoint (career firsts computed from the verified discography); API playground + transmission decoder pages. v0.10.0: upload-sessions endpoint (61 sessions clustered from vault upload dates). Changelog endpoint (site construction history from git log). First-and-last endpoint (per-year opening/closing transmissions). v0.11.0: milestone-watch endpoint (vault tracks near round-number play counts).

skills.note: Hand-maintained markdown playbooks; not generated by scripts/build_*.py.

index.description: Manifest: every endpoint with description, schema URL, updated timestamp, record counts, and deprecation notes. Start here.
index.notes: meta.version mirrors the top-level version field.

artist.description: The source of truth: artist record - bio, facts, discography (219 entries), platforms, eras, vault, upcoming. data/artist.json feeds the site renderer and mirrors it.

codex.description: The vocabulary codex: 16 word families with per-family track lists.

release-slugs.description: Slug index for the generated release pages: ordinal string -> slug.

on-this-day.description: Calendar index: transmissions keyed by MM-DD upload date.

years.description: Year-in-review archive: per-year stats and highlights, 2018-2026.

circle.description: The collaborators: 21 voices parsed from title credits.
circle.notes: Title-credit only; producers live in scene-figures.json.

milestones.description: Career firsts computed from the verified discography: firsts, records, silences.

sessions.description: Upload sessions: 61 studio sessions clustered from vault upload dates (7-day gap rule).
sessions.notes: Computed clusters, not artist-named studio sessions.

changelog.description: Site construction history, generated from the git log.
changelog.notes: A changelog built from git log cannot record its own sync commit (wave-15 convention, WAVELOG.md).

first-last.description: Per year 2018-2026: the opening and closing transmissions.

milestone-watch.description: Milestone watch: vault tracks near round-number play counts.
milestone-watch.notes: Play counts are a 2026-10-11 snapshot; they drift.

scene-figures.description: Scene figures: producer credits and scene research outside the 21 (e.g. Fish Narc).

transmission.description: The guided journey: six eras with stats, top tracks, key sessions, collaborators, milestones, and computed signal lines.

network.description: Collaboration network: artist-centered nodes (21 title-credited collaborators + producer scene figures), track-weighted edges, co-credit links, computed insights.
network.notes: 23 nodes / 27 edges; no producer-collaborator edges exist on record.

eras.description: Era deep-dives: six eras with full transmission lists (every track + plays), ALL in-era collaborators, active codex families, milestones, computed signal lines and summaries. Data source for the eras/<id>.html deep-dive pages.
eras.notes: collaborators[] holds every in-era voice; transmission.json keeps only the top 3.

session-clusters.description: Session archaeology, interactive: the 61 upload sessions as an explorable timeline - per-session enrichment (era, loudest + deepest-cut tracks, title-credited collaborators, deep-dive/era/journey cross-links), the 60 inter-session gaps, activity seasons, and asserted insights. Data source for sessions-explorer.html.
session-clusters.notes: Seasons are a computed browsing convention (silence > 90 days opens a new season), not artist-named eras.

codex-families.description: Codex family deep-dives: the 16 vocabulary families with decoded readings (traced verbatim to codex.json epithets; unknown where the archive assigns no meaning), era-by-era evolution, key sessions, and title-credited collaborators. Data source for the codex/<slug>.html deep-dive pages.

milestone-races.description: The milestone race: approaching play-count milestones as races (current value, target, gap, and pace-arithmetic estimates - never predictions), the 30,088-play summit chase, session and era record book, and the most recently crossed milestones. Data source for milestone-race.html.
milestone-races.notes: Pace figures are arithmetic on the 2026-10-11 snapshot, not predictions.

documents.AGENT.md: Agent operator's manual: base URL pattern, key endpoints with example requests, end-to-end workflows, rate/expectation notes.
documents.agents.html: Human + agent surface: 18-endpoint table, llms files, skills, search-index usage, rates & expectations, worked workflows.
documents.API.md: Human-readable API reference incl. the shared cross-site conventions block.
documents.llms.txt: Short agent brief: catalog shape, method, API map, key verified facts, ops.
documents.llms-full.txt: Full agent brief: per-era detail, collaborator research notes, unknowns register, page map, generator order.
